## Capture moments anytime in the background
Take photos, record video, or record audio in the background. Start and stop capture from hardware buttons or Control Center.

screenshots.accessibilityText: Camera, quality, frame rate, and capture trigger settings
Background recording, save location, audio, and haptic settings

views.markdown:
- Capture from the front, rear, 0.5x Ultra Wide, or 1x camera
- Configure video quality, frame rate, save location, and filename format
- Trigger each action from Control Center or configurable volume and power-button gestures
- Keep music or a call playing while recording
- Optional haptic confirmation and lock-screen safeguards

*Use background capture only where permitted and obtain any required consent.*

For full details and purchase information, please visit the [official website](https://m4fn3.github.io/repo/web/K2gecamen.html).

## 1.1.0 - 2026-06-14
- Added background audio and video recording without interrupting music or calls. This is enabled by default.
- Fixed blue color casts in photos and the first seconds of videos.
- Localized settings into English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese and refreshed the settings UI.
- Added roothide support and fixed the Volume Up + Down action.

## 1.0.6 - 2026-04-27
- Updated licensing and activation internals.

## 1.0.5 - 2025-12-19
- Added long-press Power as a capture action.
- Fixed screenshots incorrectly triggering double-press actions.
- Improved capture status handling and haptic feedback for starts, stops, failures, and interruptions.

## 1.0.4 - 2025-12-12
- Added iOS 17 support on NathanLR.

## 1.0.3 - 2024-06-11
- Added an option to keep Apple's Camera app recording in the background.
- Added options to ignore actions while other audio is playing and improved lock-screen safeguards.

## 1.0.2 - 2024-06-06
- Added haptic feedback.
- Disabled the photo shutter sound and fixed capture-action selection issues.

## 1.0.1 - 2024-05-28
- Added frame-rate settings, more activation methods, lock-screen safeguards, and 0.5x Ultra Wide support.
- Improved photo capture.

## 1.0.0 - 2024-04-06
- Initial public release.
